guard: `cotal up --foreground` over this folder's running stack refuses with the `cotal down` remedy and leaves the broker running, instead of printing `already running` and exiting 0
why: The suite drives the shipped binary (`tsx bin/cotal.ts`) against a real detached broker on an allocated port, so the refusal is observed as the CLI's exit code and stderr, not inferred from a source string.
The mutation removes only the `--foreground` refusal in the refresh branch, so a red must come from the exit-code cell that names it.

mutations.name: drop the --foreground refusal on refresh
mutations.expectRed: foreground up over a running stack must not succeed
mutations.cell: foreground up over a running stack must not succeed
mutations.note: `bin/cotal.ts` imports `@cotal-ai/cli`, which resolves to `dist/`, so the mutant is built before the run and the restored source is rebuilt after. With the refusal gone, the refresh branch prints `✓ already running` and exits 0, which the first refusal cell rejects.
